title: dryopteris augescens var. puberula
intro: Dryopteris augescens var. puberula, commonly known as the pubescent shield fern, is a type of flowering plant in the Dryopteridaceae family. It is a fern species native to mountainous regions, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Dryopteris augescens var. puberula include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve liver function, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, hepatoprotective, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
